description: This PHP script generates a pie chart representing test plan metrics and results in the TestLink project. It includes setup for chart customization, data retrieval from the database, and drawing the pie chart with labels and legend.

classes.name: pData
classes.description: Class representing the dataset for the chart, used to add points and series.

classes.name: pChart
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering the chart, setting colors, and drawing the pie graph.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view test plan metrics.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates input arguments from GET/POST, managing access control based on API key.
